observation: Glass fragments appear clustered near the impact area with little outward spread/trajectory; the event reads more like a small pile of debris than an explosive shatter driven by a fast brick.
expected_behavior: A high-speed brick impact should produce a clear radial fracture pattern and shards erupting outward from the impact point, with visible directional debris spread and tumbling pieces catching highlights.
actual_behavior: Shards are few/chunky and remain in a dark cluster; no clear radial crack propagation or energetic outward dispersion is visible in-frame.
